cast_spell.description:
Cast one of the package's executable prepared spells using its admitted spell definition and reusable resolution family.
For Web or Cloud of Daggers, set known_area=true only when the player knows the committed spell area from observing the cast or another established fact. Omitted or false means hidden on the combat map. This fact does not reveal its caster or any creature, authorize movement, or change spell mechanics. In combat, Flame Strike requires environment_origin as its chosen Cylinder point; saved positions determine recipients, range and cover. In combat, Fear uses the saved body facing or instant_area_direction/apex for its Cone; Sleep chooses environment_origin for its Sphere. Saved positions determine actual recipients, range, plane and clear paths. For Misty Step outside combat, supply exactly one established destination fact record: its named place, actual current_plane and destination plane, horizontal_distance_feet, signed elevation_change_feet (negative means downward), visible and unoccupied. Do not invent these facts; the destination must be on the current plane and within the original 30-foot straight-line range, including either upward or downward elevation. Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.
Outside combat, Find Steed and Summon Dragon use established fictional placement. Supply created_actor_placement (a short established location), created_actor_distance in feet, created_actor_space_unoccupied=true and created_actor_clear_path=true. Summon Dragon also requires created_actor_space_visible=true; Find Steed does not. These facts do not create coordinates. The paid creature keeps its exact saved ID and source statistics. At later combat entry, explicitly include its same ID, printed Large box footprint, actual height/position/plane/ambient lighting and source metadata in combat_scenes. Combat movement, mounting and attacks use that admitted body. Exploration Steed abilities and mounting use current fiction as described by their tools. Combat casting still uses the authoritative scene and its actual placement/sight checks.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies. Outside combat, Mage Hand uses current fictional placement, nearest caster separation and actual clear-path/contact facts, including its cargo and shared plane. No combat turn or map is required. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster. Outside combat, Thaumaturgy uses current established origin_distance, origin_has_clear_path and minor_same_plane facts for remote wonders, flames and doors/windows, even when an old combat map is saved. Use the exact admitted minor_object_id and existing subject/access/flame facts. Altered Eyes and Booming Voice affect the actual caster. No exploration coordinates are inferred.
